Title: Verify that a customer can click a Dynamic payment link and complete a guest checkout card payment successfully
Preconditions:
Pre Conditions:
The following should be true before proceeding:
- A merchant has generated a Dynamic payment link (amount not pre-set)
- The customer does not have a GK One account, or chooses not to use one
- The card used is issued by a bank/issuer that requires 3D Secure authentication
Postconditions:
Post Conditions:
The following should be true after test completion:
- The payment is completed successfully
- A confirmation receipt is available showing merchant name and amount, with no merchant email address displayed anywhere
- An email notification confirming successful payment is sent to the customer's registered email address
Tags: GK Pay Biz; Payment Link; Guest Checkout; Smoke

Step Action: Click the merchant's payment link
Step Expected: A browser-based payment interface opens

Step Action: Observe the amount field
Step Expected: The amount field is blank and editable

Step Action: Enter a valid payment amount and an optional note
Step Expected: Values are accepted; the Payee cannot be changed

Step Action: Select/tap the merchant name to open the merchant info modal
Step Expected: Modal opens showing "Powered by" and Business Name, Business Email, Contact Number, Business Address

Step Action: Close the modal and select "Checkout as guest" (or equivalent guest option)
Enter a valid full name (e.g. "Naomi Silvera") and a valid email address
Step Expected: Values are accepted

Step Action: Enter valid card details: cardholder name, a valid card number, a valid future expiry date (MM/YYYY), and a valid CVV for the card brand
Tap "Make payment"
Step Expected: The customer is redirected to the card issuer's authentication page

Step Action: Complete the 3DS challenge successfully
Step Expected: The issuer returns approval and payment processing continues

Step Action: Observe the result screen
Step Expected: Payment success confirmation is shown, with the merchant name and amount displayed
